description: Atlyn Process Lens displays prepared activity-to-activity transitions as an interactive process map in Power BI. Explore transition frequency, supplied duration statistics, cycles, and repeated activities without removing them from the graph. Search activities, focus on nearby, upstream, or downstream connections, compare supplied variants, and inspect visible transitions in a table. The visual consumes a prepared transition table: source activity, target activity, and transition frequency are required. Optional fields include a duration statistic, variant, stable prepared-row identifier, and tooltips. Define the statistic, unit, and preparation method in format settings so readers know what a displayed duration means. Frequency values can add across contributing rows. Duration is shown only when an edge has one eligible prepared contributor; it becomes unavailable when duplicate or cross-variant contributors would require aggregation. The visual does not invent a combined mean, median, or percentile. Use one prepared row per edge and variant and preserve row identity. Graph processing is local and does not require an external process-analysis service, telemetry, or runtime entitlement call. Author acquisition and use require an active paid or trial Atlyn all-access subscription under the Atlyn customer terms. The one-seat all-access list price is $14.99/month or $149/year…
